independentActualObservations.scientificCorrectness: Actual v4 retains circular bacterial DNA and a linear two-ended nuclear DNA fragment. Red mRNA arises from nuclear DNA, crosses the drawn pore and enters a cytoplasmic ribosome. Green charged tRNA delivers an amino-acid symbol; both ribosomes output linked multi-bead polypeptides. Four lower motifs remain distinct enzyme, structural fibre, membrane transport and immune-defence examples. The channel arrow crosses the bilayer. These are symbolic cell/protein models, not full atom structures or actual laboratory data.
independentActualObservations.labelsAndObjectMapping: Numbers1–6 and arrows map correctly:1 DNA,2 mRNA,3 tRNA,4 Ribosom,5 Kernpore,6 Protein. The pore number occurs only in the nucleated cell. No misplaced tRNA/ribosome, circular nuclear genome, nucleus in the bacterium or reversed transcription is drawn.
independentActualObservations.original: Both complete cell flows, all pointer endpoints, the linear versus ring DNA and long chains were actually inspected. The six large legend terms and four separate protein-role labels accurately describe the objects.
independentActualObservations.phone360: The actual360×203 view has a readable six-term numbered legend; all six mechanism names and the Bakterium/Zelle mit Kern headings are independently legible. Objects/pointers retain their distinct roles. The lower Enzyme/Struktur/Transport/Abwehr labels are also readable. This directly remedies the previous tiny scattered technical labels.
independentActualObservations.desktop680: The actual680×383 view clearly preserves both cell routes, six object-number mappings and four role motifs without cropping or reliance on the original.
independentActualObservations.captionAlt: Actual caption and alt match the six-term legend and ring/linear DNA distinction, pore export and lower functional motifs. No complete functional protein is inferred from a tiny sequence fragment.
independentActualObservations.perspective: No person handles a directional instrument or document. Both cells and the numbered legend use the outside viewer perspective consistently.
independentActualObservations.resolvedPriorFacet: The phone-readability HOLD on candidate-v2 is resolved for this actual candidate-v4 only. The original FIRST/held predecessor remain unchanged.
independentActualObservations.remainingLimits: This is visual orientation, not witnessed learner mechanism explanation or real biosynthesis. Native/context/current-resource D/P/V integration is still pending.

independentActualObservations.scientificCorrectness: Actual v3 shows six schematic phases: entry/RNA→DNA, blue viral DNA embedded in host DNA, transcription with separate RNA routes to host translation and genome packaging, linked polypeptide production at a ribosome, membrane assembly/budding with two RNA copies and an immature inner layer, then protease-symbol cleavage and a characteristic mature conical core. Both immature and mature particles retain two depicted genomic RNA copies. Only the mature particle has the conical core; no cone is assigned to the immature Gag layer.
independentActualObservations.labelsAndObjectMapping: RNA→DNA, Integration, Neue RNA, Proteine/Ribosom, Aufbau+Knospung and Reifung/Unreif/Reif match the actual panels. Numbers1→2→3 across the top then4→5→6 along the lower reverse direction make the main phase order explicit. The local6-panel arrow Unreif→Reif is a separate maturation comparison. Red arrows route newly transcribed RNA to translation and to the budding particle; black arrows route protein production/assembly and the next numbered phase.
independentActualObservations.original: Every RNA-copy pair, nuclear integration segment, RNA-route arrow, linked chain, budding neck and immature-versus-mature core shape was actually inspected. Main arrows enter the numbered phase panels; the6-panel internal arrow specifies maturation rather than an exact nucleus/capsid molecular trajectory.
independentActualObservations.phone360: The actual360×203 view makes the six headings and numbered route readable, including RNA→DNA, Integration, Neue RNA and Ribosom. Aufbau+Knospung is the smallest heading but remains readable as a single phase. The immature round-inner-layer versus mature cone and two RNA symbols are distinct. No central mechanism requires the prior4–6px crowded cell labels.
independentActualObservations.desktop680: The actual680×383 view shows all phase names, the packaging-versus-translation branch, host ribosome and the Unreif/Reif comparison clearly.
independentActualObservations.captionAlt: Caption and alt describe both new RNA destinations, budding and maturation with the characteristic conical mature core, and explicitly allow maturation alongside or after budding. No universal claim that every real mature particle must be geometrically identical is inferred from the characteristic example. The former RT-minus marker is absent and is not falsely retained in this caption; possible mechanistic intervention remains a separate whole-case explanation.
independentActualObservations.perspective: No actor or diagnostic instrument; numbered comic panel sequence and molecular arrows are outside-view schematics. No patient, drug dose or clinical outcome is depicted.
independentActualObservations.resolvedPriorFacet: The phone-readability HOLD on candidate-v1 is resolved for this actual candidate-v3. The additional explicit genome-packaging/maturation drawing was scientifically checked as new actual content, not inherited from the prior generic schematic.
independentActualObservations.remainingLimits: Six didactic phases condense several biological substeps. It is not a complete molecular/clinical HIV simulation or learner proof. Native/context/current-resource D/P/V integration remains pending.
